question:
Identify the error in the sentence.

By the time they arrive, the concert had ended.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error lies in the tense usage of the verb "**arrive**" in the sentence.
 
• The sentence uses "**had ended**" to indicate the past perfect tense, which refers to an event completed before another event in the past.
 
• For consistency, the verb "**arrive**" should also be in the past tense ("arrived").
